title: 8-bit and 16-bit Music Generator by DougVeira
author: Major-Tax4200
selftext:
A significant update has been released!  
In addition to the three texture options for generated music, the program now also includes a randomized sound effects generator for games.  
This makes the tool even more complete, especially for solo developers who have to handle many different aspects of their projects on their own.  
You can generate random music prototypes using a carefully designed algorithm that creates unique, varied, and musical combinations for your games. The music can also be exported in WAV and MIDI formats.  
Now, in addition to creating music, you can also experiment with generating sound effects for your projects.  
The goal is to make the development process easier and give solo developers a practical tool for creating audio during prototyping and development.  
If you’re an indie developer or working on a game by yourself, take a look at the tool and see if it can help with your next project.  
Check out the generator and give it a try!
